subject: Inference runbook lab — SignalDrive engineer exchange & readiness
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@signaldrive.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. The team left feeling good about Redwood’s latency profile and the KV cache options; we’d like to move to a hands-on engineering session to validate topology and get a runbook for staging.

Attendees from our side: Alex (platform), Priya (infra), and our head of security (security@signaldrive.com). Goal: confirm network requirements, service-to-service auth, and a quick proof that our sample model can run within your suggested batch/latency settings.

Availability (PST):
- Tue Mar 2: 10:00–12:30
- Wed Mar 3: 13:00–17:00

We prefer a 2.5-hour block but can split into 90/60 if needed. Can you propose times and an agenda? Also, please attach any pre-call checklist we should fill out (network CIDRs, sample dataset size, credentials pattern).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Platform Lead | SignalDrive
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Hi Alex —

Great to hear — we can definitely run an engineer exchange + lab. Thanks for listing attendees. Suggested approach: one combined session focused on connectivity and a short run-through of an inference runbook, followed by a hands-on lab where we exercise your model end-to-end.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 2, 09:30–12:00 (2.5 hrs) 
- Wed Mar 3, 14:00–16:30 (2.5 hrs)

If your security team wants to keep the session shorter, we can split into two: 60 mins (architecture + SSO/KMS/Network) + 60 mins (lab + tuning).

Pre-reqs we need from you (short):
- Temporary SSH/VPN ingress CIDR for a testing host (we’ll provide an IP to whitelist)
- Sample model artifact (link or S3 path) and typical sequence lengths
- Estimated QPS for the test (burst and steady)

I’ve attached a one-page "discovery-summary.pdf" you sent and a short "env-checklist.xlsx" we use to capture the items above. Ben will lead the lab on our side; I’ll run the architecture portion.

Agenda (high-level):
1) 15m — introductions & goals
2) 45m — topology & network auth (priors: KMS, service account flows)
3) 60m — hands-on lab (deploy sample config, run endpoints, measure latency)
4) 30m — Q&A / next steps / runbook handoff

If that looks good let me know which slot you prefer and whether to split into two shorter sessions.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Alex —

I can take point on the hands-on portion. If you pick Tue 9:30–12:00 PST I’ll plan a small CI/CD snippet to spin the test harness and a pre-seeded dataset so we can measure tail latency.

Quick ask for your infra lead before the lab: will you be able to open a temporary S3 path or pre-share a container image? That speeds the setup.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@signaldrive.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 12:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear agenda.

Small change: our head of platform has a calendar conflict on Tue morning and asked if we can move to Wed. Wed 14:00–16:30 PST still works for most folks, but our security lead can only attend on the 26th (Fri) morning between 10:00–11:30 PST. They specifically want to review SOC 2 controls and logging capture (audit logs, retention) during the meeting.

Can we either:
A) keep the main lab on Wed 14:00–16:30 and run a 30–45m separate security-focused call with their lead on Fri 26 10:00–11:30, or
B) split the lab across Wed (architecture + lab) and Fri (security & audit deep-dive)

Also, could you attach SOC 2 summary or a pointer to compliance artifacts so our security lead can review before Friday?

We can provide a pre-shared S3 path for the model and an access token — will share that once slot is confirmed.

Alex
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Alex —

We’re flexible. Option B works well: do Wed Mar 3 for the combined architecture + lab (14:00–16:30 PST) and schedule a focused security session on Fri Mar 5 at 10:00–11:00 PST (we have a short window). I’ll attach our internal runbook and a SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and the updated lab runbook (lab-runbook-v2.pdf).

Proposed calendar items:
- Wed Mar 3, 14:00–16:30 PST — Inference runbook lab (Zoom link & calendar invite below)
- Fri Mar 5, 10:00–11:00 PST — Security & audit Q&A (smaller group)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321
Calendar (add): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=signaldrive_lab_20270226

Attachments included: lab-runbook-v2.pdf, env-checklist.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (security team requested detailed artifacts; we’ll follow our evidence share flow after their NDA).

Ben — I’ll assign the lab steps 1–4 to you in the invite and include links to the CI template. Priyom — can you pick the test instance flavor (g4dn-sim or a2-highmem) and I’ll include that in the runbook?

Thanks — I’ll send invites once Alex confirms the approach.

Best,
Mina
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@signaldrive.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, security@signaldrive.com
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer exchange / lab request

Mina —

That plan works for us. Please go ahead and send the invites for Wed Mar 3 (14:00–16:30 PST) and Fri Mar 5 (10:00–11:00 PST). We’ll pre-share the S3 link and token by EOD Monday.

One ask from our side: can you record the architecture portion and include the runbook as a follow-up artifact in the calendar invite so our wider infra team can review asynchronously?

Looking forward to the lab — thanks for moving quickly.

Best,
Alex
